# Be Well Counseling Services

> Online therapy and EMDR with Nancy Funkhouser, MSW, LICSW, MBA, an EMDRIA Certified EMDR Therapist. Serving adults and young adults (17+) located in Massachusetts, Illinois and North Carolina. Based in Wayland, Massachusetts; all sessions are online.

Nancy works with people who want to better understand themselves, navigate life's challenges, and create meaningful change: feeling stuck, facing a transition, working through difficult experiences, or wanting life to feel different. Her approach is active and collaborative ("an active participant, not a silent note-taker"), drawing on EMDR, Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, Solution-Focused Therapy, strengths-based work and Positive Psychology.

## Key facts

- Clinician: Nancy Funkhouser, MSW, LICSW, MBA (Licensed Independent Clinical Social Worker; EMDRIA Certified EMDR Therapist; member, National Association of Social Workers)
- Licensed in: Massachusetts, Illinois, North Carolina (clients must be located in one of these states during sessions)
- Ages: 17 and up (young adults and adults)
- Format: online only, via Google Meet
- Session length: 55 minutes, weekly or bi-weekly
- Fee: $200 per session; reduced fee available on inquiry
- Insurance: in network with BCBS only; out-of-network for other plans, with receipts (superbills) provided
- Payment: major credit cards, HSA and FSA cards
- Focus areas: anxiety, stress, depression, trauma, life transitions, relationships, parenting, academic and career pressure
- First step: a free 15-minute phone call
- Phone: 781-771-0687
- Email: nancy@bewellcounseling.llc

## Note

This practice cannot respond to emergencies. In a crisis, call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline) or call 911.
